summary: CALIGULA HOLDING AS (org. no. 998 320 380) is a private limited company (AS) based in Moss, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-05-02. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 86.221 (Spesialiserte legetjenester, unntatt psykiatriske legetjenester); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 324 321. Board chair: Malte Sebastian Robert Hübner; auditor: KROGH REVISJON AS.
